name: Programmed Illusion

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: An illusion of sight and sound that performs a scripted scene when a condition you set occurs.
text: The scene fits in a 30-foot Cube and runs for up to 5 minutes, then can play again after 10 minutes. Physical interaction or a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your DC reveals it as an illusion.
